tasks.label: Start Vite Dev Server
tasks.command: npm run dev

tasks.label: Stop Vite Dev Server
tasks.command: taskkill /F /IM node.exe

tasks.label: Compose Up (Debug)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml up -d --build

tasks.label: Compose Down (Debug)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml down

tasks.label: Media Acquisition Service Compose Up (Debug)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml up -d --build media-acquisition-service

tasks.label: Media Acquisition Service Compose Down (Debug)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml down media-acquisition-service

tasks.label: Media Catalog Service Compose Up (Debug)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml up -d --build media-catalog-service

tasks.label: Media Catalog Service Compose Down (Debug)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml down media-catalog-service

tasks.label: Media Stream Service Compose Up (Debug)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml up -d --build media-stream-service

tasks.label: Media Stream Service Compose Down (Debug)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml down media-stream-service

tasks.label: Open Gateway Logs
tasks.command: docker logs home_media_server-api-gateway-service-1 --tail 50 -f

tasks.label: Open Acquisition Logs
tasks.command: docker logs home_media_server-media-acquisition-service-1 --tail 50 -f

tasks.label: Open Catalog Logs
tasks.command: docker logs home_media_server-media-catalog-service-1 --tail 50 -f

tasks.label: Open Stream Logs
tasks.command: docker logs home_media_server-media-stream-service-1 --tail 50 -f

tasks.label: Build Shared Library
tasks.command: mvn clean install

tasks.label: Hot Update Backend: API Gateway
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' ; mvn -f backend/pom.xml -pl api-gateway-service -am clean package -DskipTests ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; $cid=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q api-gateway-service) ; if (-not $cid) { throw 'api-gateway-service container is not running' } ; docker cp backend/api-gateway-service/target/api-gateway-service-0.1.0.jar ${cid}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker restart $cid

tasks.label: Hot Update Backend: Catalog
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' ; mvn -f backend/pom.xml -pl media-catalog-service -am clean package -DskipTests ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; $cid=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q media-catalog-service) ; if (-not $cid) { throw 'media-catalog-service container is not running' } ; docker cp backend/media-catalog-service/target/media-catalog-service-0.1.0.jar ${cid}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker restart $cid

tasks.label: Hot Update Backend: Acquisition
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' ; mvn -f backend/pom.xml -pl media-acquisition-service -am clean package -DskipTests ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; $cid=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q media-acquisition-service) ; if (-not $cid) { throw 'media-acquisition-service container is not running' } ; docker cp backend/media-acquisition-service/target/media-acquisition-service-0.1.0.jar ${cid}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker restart $cid

tasks.label: Hot Update Backend: Stream
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' ; mvn -f backend/pom.xml -pl media-stream-service -am clean package -DskipTests ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; $cid=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q media-stream-service) ; if (-not $cid) { throw 'media-stream-service container is not running' } ; docker cp backend/media-stream-service/target/media-stream-service-0.1.0.jar ${cid}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker restart $cid

tasks.label: Hot Update Backend: All Services
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' ; mvn -f backend/pom.xml clean package -DskipTests ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; $gateway=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q api-gateway-service) ; $catalog=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q media-catalog-service) ; $acquisition=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q media-acquisition-service) ; $stream=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q media-stream-service) ; if (-not $gateway -or -not $catalog -or -not $acquisition -or -not $stream) { throw 'One or more backend containers are not running' } ; docker cp backend/api-gateway-service/target/api-gateway-service-0.1.0.jar ${gateway}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker cp backend/media-catalog-service/target/media-catalog-service-0.1.0.jar ${catalog}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker cp backend/media-acquisition-service/target/media-acquisition-service-0.1.0.jar ${acquisition}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker cp backend/media-stream-service/target/media-stream-service-0.1.0.jar ${stream}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker restart $gateway $catalog $acquisition $stream

tasks.label: Ensure + Hot Update Backend: All Services
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' ; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml up -d api-gateway-service media-catalog-service media-acquisition-service media-stream-service ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; mvn -f backend/pom.xml clean package -DskipTests ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; $gateway=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q api-gateway-service) ; $catalog=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q media-catalog-service) ; $acquisition=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q media-acquisition-service) ; $stream=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q media-stream-service) ; if (-not $gateway -or -not $catalog -or -not $acquisition -or -not $stream) { throw 'One or more backend containers are not running' } ; docker cp backend/api-gateway-service/target/api-gateway-service-0.1.0.jar ${gateway}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker cp backend/media-catalog-service/target/media-catalog-service-0.1.0.jar ${catalog}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker cp backend/media-acquisition-service/target/media-acquisition-service-0.1.0.jar ${acquisition}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker cp backend/media-stream-service/target/media-stream-service-0.1.0.jar ${stream}:/app/app.jar ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker restart $gateway $catalog $acquisition $stream

tasks.label: Hot Update Frontend Container
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' ; npm --prefix frontend run build ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; $cid=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q frontend) ; if (-not $cid) { throw 'frontend container is not running' } ; $cleanupCommand = 'rm -rf /usr/share/nginx/html/*' ; & docker exec $cid sh -c $cleanupCommand ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker cp frontend/dist/. ${cid}:/usr/share/nginx/html/

tasks.label: Ensure + Hot Update Frontend Container
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' ; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml up -d frontend ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; npm --prefix frontend run build ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; $cid=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.debug.yaml ps -q frontend) ; if (-not $cid) { throw 'frontend container is not running' } ; $cleanupCommand = 'rm -rf /usr/share/nginx/html/*' ; & docker exec $cid sh -c $cleanupCommand ; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } ; docker cp frontend/dist/. ${cid}:/usr/share/nginx/html/
